proposal.summary: Batch Q3 (CM550 0x10000-0x1ffff) holds seven families. (1) The cylinder balancing feature (e2m 823C calibration / 823D state, enabled in this dump: CBDEN = 1, CBDCEN = 0): a tooth interrupt step fills the cylinder segment speed buffers, a once-per-cycle step turns them into six acceleration samples, a six-point Fourier analysis, learned dynamics compensation and per-cylinder fueling trims (in firing order 1-5-3-6-2-4), and a start-up initializer; the CM848 counterparts are the hpcr_cbd* functions. (2) The J1939 engine configuration (PGN 65251) torque curve: the percent peak torque and friction fueling at the breakpoints (two CM848 twins), the fault derate (EPF) and throttle 100 requesters that set the curve's speed points and fuelings through the request flags of e2m 12BB (one more twin). (3) Fueling tables: the 4D fueling calculation (steady state / transient blend by the alpha) and the start-up initializers of its lookups (one twin, cm848_initFaultSeverityTables). (4) Engine protection: the fault derate fuel limit (task 2 of the derate scheduler), the shutdown counting initializer and the fuel temperature input (VP44 pump or ECM sensor, e2m 81F9 / 81FA). (5) The engine position signal set-up per wheel configuration (TPU channels 10 / 0 / 1, three of them empty slots) and the EPS main / backup phase comparator. (6) Crank initial advance by intake manifold temperature, the J1922 MID 74 engine control handler and the inactive fault clear. Several vp44_ prefixes were wrong (cylinder balancing, the fuel temperature selector); the TPU set-ups and handlers keep mc68k_.

functions.plate_comment: Cylinder balancing speed buffer fill, called by the four TPU channel 10 primary speed interrupt handlers while cylinder_balance_enable_flag (e2m 823C +34 CBDEN) is 1. The tooth number is the low byte of TPU_CH15_PARAM6 (+36 on the second crank revolution, CMSYFG); at cylinder_balance_start_tooth (CBDST) it restarts the segment. functions.role: Once per 40-frame cycle it turns the speed buffers into acceleration samples, Fourier components, learned dynamics compensation and the six cylinder balancing fueling trims, and writes the per-cylinder fueling offsets.

functions.plate_comment: The cylinder balancing calculation, frame 38 of executiveFrameInterruptHandler (once per 200 ms) while CBDEN = 1. With a new buffer (CBDSBRF) it forms the six acceleration samples CBDAXB1-6 (speed buffer n - n+1) and a six-point Fourier analysis (CBDFRC1 / CBDFIC1 / CBDFRC2 / CBDFIC2 / CBDFRC3, sin 60 = 866/1000), sets the stop compensation flag CBDSCF from the active trim gain table, the speed change (CBDDST) and the engine state, removes the learned dynamics compensation (CBDDCT / CBDI2DCT by engine speed, learned while motoring between CBDLSL and CBDUSL, reset by CBDDCR) into CBDARC2 / CBDAIC2 and the component 3 adjustment into CBDARC3. It picks the trim patterns CBDTI1-3 from the reference vectors, the magnitudes CBDFM1-3 and the trim increments (normal or small gain against the threshold table CBDFT), and with CBDCEN set, cam and crank in sync, no recent cylinder cutout (CBDDSTM), road speed up to CBDVSTD and coolant / intake temperature above CBDCLTP / CBDIMTP it adds the ROM pattern trims to the saved trims (CBDDFTO, EEPROM), applies the limits CBDFTMN..CBDFTMX with limit mode CBDLMMD, removes the mean and stores them back. Last it writes 0x80a1ac-0x80a1b6 = FLFLAJC1-6 + trim x CBDATG / 100 (trims in firing order 1-5-3-6-2-4) and clears CBDSBRF.

functions.plate_comment: The 4D fueling of user fueling state DUAL_AXIS_FUEL_DEMAND_TABLE (its caller stores the result in four_dimensional_fueling, e2m 1053 +0 5DFL). The throttle is commanded_throttle_state.commanded_throttle (limited to the 4D steady state y axis point 3 with programmable power); with throttle 0 the result is fuel_demand_minimum. Otherwise it reads the steady state (when four_dimensional_fueling_interpolation_factor, the alpha, is not 0) and the transient table (when it is below 0x4000) at engine_rpm_primary, each kept between its 0 and 100 percent throttle curves without programmable power, blends them by the alpha (Q14), adds four_dimensional_fueling_increment_cal (125A +C 5DFLAJ), and limits the sum to at least fuel_demand_minimum and at most four_dimensional_fueling_user_maximum (5DIRMXFL), which it then reloads with 5888. CM848's counterpart reads the filtered throttle and has no increment.

functions.role: Handles the J1922 engine control message of source 74 (MID 0x4a): validates it, applies the source's TSC1-style configuration and sets the override mode with its speed / torque / limit request and the retarder, high idle and driveline bits.
functions.discriminator: Reached only for MID 74 in the J1922 branch of mc68k_dispatchJ1708ReceivedMessages; source 74 in refreshEngineTsc1IgnoredRequestEntry / findTsc1SourceConfiguration, lengths 3 / 5 / 4 / 5 by mode (the MID 79 handler 0x1f8bc uses 2 / 3).
functions.plate_comment: J1922 engine control request from source 74 (J1708 MID 0x4a; called by mc68k_dispatchJ1708ReceivedMessages while J1922 communication is enabled). The override mode is control byte bits 0-1 and the record length must be 3 / 5 / 4 / 5 for modes 0-3. After refreshEngineTsc1IgnoredRequestEntry(0, 74) it takes the source's entry with findTsc1SourceConfiguration(0 = J1922 data link, 74), unless a higher entry already controls, and sets tsc1_override_control_mode, engine_control_network_type 0 and datalink_command_source_id 74. Mode 1 loads the speed reference (bytes 3-4 / 2), mode 2 the torque byte as fueling (no load fueling + (j1939_peak_fueling_tau_0 - j1939_friction_load_fueling_at_breakpoint_4) x percent / 0x6400), mode 3 the speed limit (byte 3 x 128) and the signed torque limit (byte 4) as fueling, each with the entry's request timeout; control bits 2 / 3 / 4 set the retarder, high idle override and driveline disengage states. The J1939 analogue is processEngineTsc1Request; CM848 has no J1922.

roles.role: Fills the cylinder balancing speed buffers. All four TPU channel 10 primary speed interrupt handlers (modes 0-3) call it. It runs with CBDEN (0x8072c0, e2m 823C +34) = 1 and engine_speed_source_select = 0, and clears CBDSBRF for any other source. When the tooth number (TPU_CH15_PARAM6 low byte, +36 on the second crank revolution) equals CBDST (0x8072dc, 823C +50 'start tooth'), it restarts the capture: segment sum 0x8002a6 = 0, count 0x8002aa = 0, index 0x8002a4 = 1. Every call adds main_engine_position_sensor_period to the sum. Every 4 calls the sum goes into a segment slot (7 longs at 0x800322). After slot 6 it copies the 7 slots, clamped to 0..150000, to CBDSB1-7 (0x8091ea-0x809202), carries slot 6 into slot 0 and sets CBDSBRF (0x8092e4, 823D +FC speed buffer ready) to 1.
roles.discriminator: It runs per tooth interrupt and is the only writer of CBDSB1-7 and CBDSBRF. 0x127c2 reads them once per 40 frames. It reads an MC68336 TPU parameter word, so the mc68k_ prefix fits the rule.
roles.cm848_counterpart: hpcr_cbdFillAccelerationBuffers @ 0x42bd0, counterpart. It has the same start-tooth gate in the crank tooth interrupt, but it stores TPU-A channel 14 timestamp differences / 4 directly into the acceleration buffers.

roles.role: Cylinder balancing trim calculation. It is the once-per-40-frames call of frame 38 (jsr at 0x1be60) and runs only under CBDEN. On a ready buffer it computes the accelerations CBDAXB1-6 = SB[n] - SB[n+1] with interrupts masked, then the Fourier terms CBDFRC1 / FIC1 / FRC2 / FIC2 / FRC3 (0x809206-0x809216, x 866/1000 = sin 60). Then: the active trim gain CBDATG (0x8092e2) from the 2-D stop compensation table (rpm, CBDFFL), capped at 100. The stop flag CBDSCF. The harmonic-2 terms CBDARC2 / CBDAIC2, corrected by the speed-binned dynamics tables CBDDCT / CBDI2DCT; it learns these tables while motoring (CBDLSL < rpm < CBDUSL) and CBDDCR resets them. CBDARC3 = FRC3 - the component 3 table. Trim indexes CBDTI1-3 from the CBDR1Cn / CBDR2Cn / CBDR3 references. Increments CBDTINC1-3 = trim gain n or the small gain, chosen by magnitude against the FFT threshold. Trim adjustments CBDTA1-6 from the ROM pattern rows 0x12596 / 0x125de / 0x12626, gated by CBDCEN, no stop, cam sync, cutout delay 0x800220 = 0, road speed <= CBDVSTD, and coolant / IMT above CBDCLTP / CBDIMTP. The trims CBDDFO1-6 = adjustment + the saved trims at 0x804158 (8241, saved at power-down). It checks them against CBDFTMX / CBDFTMN (CBDTLE; limit mode CBDLMMD 1 = power-up copy 0x8002d4, 2 = 0), removes the mean and writes them back. With CBDCEN, 0x80a1ac-0x80a1b6 = FLFLAJCn + slot trim (firing order 1-5-3-6-2-4) x CBDATG / 100, or 0 during the cutout delay. At the end it clears CBDSBRF.
roles.discriminator: It reads the speed buffers and is the only writer of the cylinder balance Fourier, trim and offset words. It reads only the FLCnENFG cutout flags from the pump block and sends nothing to the VP44, so the vp44_ prefix is wrong.
roles.cm848_counterpart: hpcr_cbdCalculateCylinderTrims @ 0x42d78, counterpart. It uses the same Fourier formulas and runs in the same once-per-40-frames kind of slot (frame 3). It low-pass filters the components, handles 4/6/8 cylinders and keeps one learned real / imaginary compensation in EEPROM, not speed-binned tables.

roles.role: Percent peak torque x 256 at one engine speed for e2m 10E2 (args: the speed and that speed's friction fuel). It looks up the steady state 4-D fueling at (speed, throttle 400) and clamps it with cm550_subtractAndClampValue. It subtracts (the friction fuel + the coolant friction correction 0x80052c), multiplies by 0x6400 and divides with saturation (cm550_safeDivideWithClamp) by JCMXT0FL (0x807d4c) - JCFCBK04 (0x80bc88).

roles.role: Sets the crank initial advance CKIITA (0x80d0a8) and its break speed CKIITAES (0x80d0b4) from the intake manifold temperature (ADIMTPFT). If IMT > CKHTIMTP, it uses CKHTIMTA / CKHTIMES. Otherwise it interpolates both: ((hi - T) x low + (T - lo) x high) / (hi - lo).

verdict.overall:
Batch Q3 checked against the CM550 asm, the decompiled code, the e2m records and the RAM dumps. It covers 37 CM550 functions, 2 CM848 functions and 140 CM550 globals. No prototypes or enum members were proposed. skipped[] is empty, so nothing stays skipped.

CM550 functions: 28 CONFIRMED and 9 AMENDED. Every amendment keeps the proposed name and fixes only the plate comment:
- 0x1266e: the CBDEN gate is inside the function, not in its callers.
- 0x133fc: the jsr instruction is at 0x1ba2c.
- 0x17baa / 0x1a350 / 0x1cad6 / 0x1dbd8: the plates cited truncated global names that do not exist.
- 0x19702: table bit 0x1a0+n is algorithm_enable_flags_26_cal bit n (history-only, no derate), not a restart enable.

Four twins are proven: 0x142d4/0x18070, 0x14348/0x1811c, 0x185f0/0x507c1c and 0x1ddb4/0x1ea94. In each pair the steps, their order, the constants and the call-graph position match.
